newsitem.title: USA: FULL TEXT - Eastman Kodak sees flat sales.
newsitem.headline: FULL TEXT - Eastman Kodak sees flat sales.

text.p: Eastman Kodak Co said its January and February sales were essentially flat with the year earlier period, reflecting modest unit volume growth, lower prices and the negative impact of foreign exchange. Kodak's stock was off 6-5/8 at 81-5/8 in early trading. A full text of the company's statement follows.
Kodak says sales were flat for January & February
ROCHESTER, N.Y.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--March 21, 1997--Eastman Kodak Company today stated that sales for January and February were essentially flat compared with the first two months of 1996.

The first two months reflect modest unit volume growth, offset by lower prices and the negative impact of foreign exchange. Growth rates in emerging markets moderated considerably in comparison with 1996.
Office Imaging revenues were excluded from the comparison.

Harry Kavetas, Chief Financial Officer and Executive Vice President, said, "Although 1997 has started more slowly than we expected, there is nothing in these first months which would cause us to change our fundamental operating plans and objectives." -0- Editor's Note: For additional information about Kodak, visit our web site on the Internet at: http://www.kodak.com/
